process_disclosure: Before decision.initial.json was written, one Bash call ran a no-op `echo placeholder` by mistake. It read no input and changed no state. decision.initial.json was not edited after it was written.
overall_reason: The update changes three contracts the old suite encodes. (1) Auto-leave: it must not be refused, must not be duplicated, and pendingConfIndex must cover it. Old AutoLeaveAdvance accepts a quota drop and requires the duplicate append that crashes the node. (2) Leader conf-change admission adds joint-state refusals, and zero-payload proposals are no longer quota-refused. Old ProposalContract/ExpectedDecision encode the old rules. (3) A demoted transferee must be aborted, and no old property states this. Executed evidence (45 TLC witness runs over Go-mapped states, 7 Go scenarios on both trees, forbidden-observation controls) confirms every edit and shows no unchanged property was affected. The evidence also confirms that the NEW code still violates the proposed AutoLeaveAdvance (no auto-leave after an election with applied==pendingConf; duplicate leave with an early Advance) and the proposed ProposalContract (empty non-Auto V2 admitted in a joint config). These are reported as implementation defects, not resolved by weakening the properties.

ProposalContract uses rewritten == RefusedConf(o.entries,1,o.pending>o.applied,o.joint) and QuotaRefuses(o.quota,weight). The observer adds joint |-> r.config.outgoing#{}.
disagreement_states: P1: joint config + V2 Auto <<AddVoter>>. Old code admits it and panics at apply; new code rewrites it. Old/proposed: TRUE/FALSE on old code, FALSE/TRUE on new.
P2: non-joint config + leave. Same pattern; the old code panics at apply.
P6: non-joint config + empty JointExplicit. Old code admits it (valid); new code refuses it. The proposed contract follows the new design.
P4: quota 3 > max 2, weight-0 proposal. Old TRUE/FALSE on the drop; FALSE/TRUE on the acceptance.
P5 (defect): joint config + empty JointExplicit. Both versions admit it and panic at apply. Proposed FALSE.
entries.note: Judgment call: refusing an empty non-Auto V2 outside a joint config (P6) follows the code's len(Changes)==0 predicate and its 'refusing empty conf change' reason. Only the Auto case is exercised by testdata. Admitting it was safe in the old code, so this restriction is a design adoption, not a safety requirement.

unresolved_obligations: Bounded model checking of the proposed properties on reachable states was inconclusive. The auto-leave path was never reached (canary AutoLeaveNotAppended held over 18.6M BFS states and 23M simulated states). A scenario-directed run is still needed (EV-HUNT-VACUOUS).
Prompt probing of newly added replicas (Next=lastIndex plus probe in switchToConfig) is latency/liveness only. No safety property was added; CatchupProgress is not model-checked.
ConfigurationTransitionSafety exempts all id=0 entries, including auto-leave entries. The proposed repair (exempt only bootstrap AddVoter) was not executed.

Admitted conf changes must be applicable (no panic at apply). The joint rule in ProposalContract covers P1/P2/P5, but other invalid admitted changes (for example removing the last voter) are not covered.
Pre-existing, outside the update: CampaignContract treats pending V2 entries as blocking a campaign, while numOfPendingConf counts only EntryConfChange.
